notes: Sourced from Focusrite's own Vocaster Two User Guide v2.0 (official PDF), which includes a dedicated "Vocaster Two specifications" section (Performance specifications + Physical and electrical characteristics) — this is the most authoritative source available. The unit is entirely USB-C bus-powered; there is no separate AC/DC power port. It also has Bluetooth 5.0 (omitted here — not a physical port). The phone jack is a true 3.5mm TRRS (bidirectional) and the camera jack is a 3.5mm TRS (output only); both were mapped to the catalog's "trs-3.5" id since no TRRS id exists. USB grade (usb-5g) is taken directly from the manufacturer's stated "USB 3.0" version field, though real-world bandwidth needs of this class-compliant audio device are far below 5Gbps. Desktop unit — not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.
